Context: This title is show when Studio is frozen. This is a state where the user cannot click on anything and the screen is unresponsive.

The description given to users when we want to end a window that has a known name. The user needs to know that stopping this window's program will not crash Studio, but will just kill that window. They will be able to continue working on their project and none of their work will get lost.
Source: The '%1' window is taking too long to respond. Do you want to terminate it and continue editing your place, or keep waiting?
en-us: The '%1' window is taking too long to respond. Do you want to terminate it and continue editing your place, or keep waiting?
